payload.comment: Ablation report is internally consistent and cross-stage coherent. Three scenarios (representation_off → standardize_only → standardize_hflip) show monotonic improvement in both accuracy (0.6876 → 0.7153 → 0.7373) and macro-F1 (0.6114 → 0.6534 → 0.7027), which is the expected direction when adding standardization and then hflip augmentation. All scenarios share seed 47 and the same common_split_fingerprint, confirming controlled comparison on identical data. The best ablation accuracy (0.7373) is below the base_test_accuracy (0.7802) reported in the abstention stage, consistent with the ablation removing components present in the full model. No deterministic findings exist. Schema version 1.0 is uniform across all artefacts. Prior-stage LLM-noted items (narrative 3.64-vs-3.95 text mismatch
llm_issues: Ablation does not include a raw/no-normalization/no-augmentation baseline; the closest proxy is 'representation_off' with unit-norm, which conflates L2 normalization with a true no-preprocessing control. Minor design gap, not an error.

Only three ablation configurations are reported; a more complete ablation would isolate hflip without standardize and test additional augmentations (rotation, color jitter) to attribute the 0.7373→0.7802 gap to specific components. Acceptable as a minimal ablation but limits attribution granularity.
